name: Jiangsu Bojun Industrial Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Bojun Industrial Technology Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of automotive mold and auto parts in China and internationally. The company offers steering column, bracket, lock sleeve, electric control cover, engine parts, clutch parts, shock absorbers, turbocharger parts, battery brackets for new energy vehicles, door lock base, window lifter, hinge, lock hook, frame, guide rail, speaker frame, monitor frame, and radar bracket products. It also provides handbrake, gear shift, and foot pedal components, as well as trim pieces, exhaust housing, end cone, exhaust pipe, and headlight and piping components.
